## Grading Summary

**Answer-key coverage:** 9 of 13 key items captured. Three action items are missing entirely (the e-sign packet, the retirement projection rerun at 58, and the CPA note to Margit), and one account action is captured only in part.

**Figures:** All figures in the record are the corrected, final ones — $48,210 (not the misremembered $84,000), $7,500 (not $7,000), $15,000 group LTD cap avoided, $1,000/month × 3 = $3,000. No stale figures carried through.

**Dates:** Two action-item due dates are wrong. Record 7 (roll-in confirmation) is dated 2026-10-23, but Theo committed to an answer "by Thursday," i.e., 2026-10-15. Record 8 (Marisa documents) is dated 2026-10-24, a Saturday; "end of next week" from Tuesday 10/13 is Friday 2026-10-23.

**Partial capture:** Record 3 covers only Priya's half of the backdoor Roth. Declan's December $7,500 contribution and conversion (contingent on his IRA hitting zero) is absent, so the $15,000 couple-level action is half-recorded. The figure it does carry is correct.

**Split item:** Records 5 and 6 together cover the single 529 key item. Record 6 pairs to it (it carries the amounts and covers all three children); record 5 is the split-off half.

**Not-actions:** Clean — none of the five declined or parked items (457(b), cash balance plan, 529 superfunding, lake house, 100%/90-10 allocation) appear as actions.

key_items.note: Captures partnership effective July 1, W-2 to K-1 shift, and move into the partners' profit-sharing 401(k). Omits the quarterly estimates set up by Margit and the two-year buy-in from draws, but the core event is right and no figure is wrong.
September announcement, affiliation/merger with Aldmere, Q1 2027 close all correct. Does not mention the contract honored through June 2028 or benefit harmonization, but nothing recorded is wrong.

Uses $48,210, the corrected balance Declan read off the Wrenfield app at 00:14:16, not the initial $84,000. Destination plan correct. Does not state the December 31, 2026 deadline, but the figure is right.

Captures only Priya's half: $7,500 nondeductible traditional IRA converted to her existing Roth, as soon as the account is open. The $7,500 is the corrected 2026 figure (not $7,000). Declan's matching $7,500 December contribution and conversion, and the $15,000 couple total, are not recorded anywhere.

Rowan and Ivy increased from $500 to $1,000, Callum set at $1,000, $3,000 monthly total - all final figures. Does not note the November 1, 2026 first draft. Record 5 splits off the account-opening half of this same key item.

Owner Theo and due 2026-10-31 match 'by the end of the month' at 00:21:05. Both carriers named correctly, including Pellwood as one word. Omits the true own-occupation / specialty-specific qualifier, which is acceptable wording-level detail.
Owner Priya, due 2026-10-21, correctly reflecting the move from Friday to Wednesday the 21st at 00:20:49-00:20:58. Benefits summary included.

Owner correctly reassigned to Theo (Declan taken 'off the hook' at 00:14:50). Due date wrong: recorded as 2026-10-23, but Theo said he would call the recordkeeper tomorrow and have an answer 'by Thursday,' which is 2026-10-15.

Not captured. The single e-sign packet Theo committed to assembling early next week (week of October 19) - new traditional IRAs, Wrenfield rollover paperwork, Callum's 529 and the contribution changes - appears nowhere in the record.

Not captured. Renata's commitment at 00:21:56 to rerun the projection at age 58 (2043) with updated college funding and send the plan before Thanksgiving is missing. The retirement-age change from 60 to 58 is not recorded anywhere.
Not captured. Renata's commitment at 00:11:48 to notify CPA Margit this week to expect two Forms 8606 and two 1099-Rs is absent.

Owner Declan correct, and both documents (partner group LTD certificate and the disability section of the partnership agreement) captured. Due date wrong: recorded as 2026-10-24, a Saturday; 'end of next week' from Tuesday October 13 is Friday 2026-10-23.

extra_items.note: Opening Callum's 529 is part of the same agreed action as record 6, which already covers setting Callum's account at $1,000/month alongside the Rowan and Ivy increases. The key treats opening the account and setting all three contribution amounts as one item, so this is a split of record 6 rather than an independent action.
